description: IPCC Waste Model (adapted) (WasteMod) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by IPCC, Umweltbundesamt, Öko-Institut e.V.. The model was developed to support the federal states in preparing their GHG emission inventories for the waste sector, landfill sub-sector. It was adapted by the Federal Environment Agency and Öko-Institut for use in Germany in order to take into account the specific characteristics of each country when preparing the GHG inventory. Coverage: Germany. Methodical focus: waste modelling, first oder decay method, multi-phase model. Time resolution: annual. Software: MS Excel. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Unknown. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.

outputs: The primary result of the model is the temporal development of methane emissions from municipal waste landfills in Germany. The model can be used to answer the question to what extent a change in the type and quantity of landfilled materials influences the development of methane emissions. In addition, the effects of different landfill gas collection can be considered.
